notes: Dark-first tokens for openGym (frontend/src/index.css :root). Map: bg0->--bg, bg1->--bg-el, surface->--surface, surface2->--surface-2, surface3->--surface-3, line->--sep, text1->--label, text2->--label-2, text3->--label-3, accent->--acc, accentPressed->--acc-2, onAccent->--on-acc, accentMuted->--acc-soft (solid equivalent of ~16% accent on surface). success is deliberately NOT green; pr is the personal-record/medal colour. Contrast ratios are WCAG 2 against 'surface'.

palettes.name: ember
palettes.label: Ember on Graphite
palettes.vibe: Warm graphite and chalk with one hot ember accent: a forge, not a hospital.
palettes.successTreatment: Completed sets/days use chalk (success) with a check glyph on accentMuted fill; gold (pr) only for personal records.

light.notes: Explicit light values where the derived ones fail: success apart from PR gold (graphite ink, 7.55:1 on white).

palettes.name: volt
palettes.label: Midnight Volt
palettes.vibe: Cool blue-black with an electric periwinkle: precise, calm, instrument-panel.
palettes.successTreatment: Ice blue for done states; gold shared by PR and warning, so warnings always carry an icon.

palettes.name: chalk
palettes.label: Chalk Mono
palettes.vibe: Near-monochrome black and chalk, colour only for records: brutal, editorial, Nothing-phone.
palettes.successTreatment: No status colour for success at all: white check on surface. Amber is the only hue in the UI.
